data.title: Self-certification of tax residency required
data.summary: Beispiel Direktbank AG asks Grace Mensah to complete and return an enclosed tax residency self-certification form (under the Common Reporting Standard) by 29 October 2025, because the bank's records show a German address but a phone number registered in Ghana.
data.explanation: Under the Common Reporting Standard (CRS), banks must confirm which country or countries you are a tax resident of. Your bank noticed a mismatch between your German address and a Ghanaian phone number on file, so they need you to confirm your tax residency on the enclosed form. Fill it in and send it back by the stated deadline. If you don't, the bank says it will report your account to the tax authorities of both Germany and Ghana. If you're unsure how to fill in the form (e.g. if you are tax resident in more than one country), you may want to ask a tax advisor.
